## SimulationCall.status property

True iff the call succeeded. The bundle as a whole reverts via `SimulationRevertedError` before the result is returned, so on a successful `simulate()` every entry is `true` today. Field kept for forward-compatibility with backends that may surface per-call status.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly status: boolean;
```
